chunks: Everything in this book that is narrated from al-Waṣṣāfī has been transmitted by me from Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī Mājīlawayh—may Allah be pleased with him—from Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā al-ʿAṭṭār, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā, from Ibn Faḍḍāl, from ʿUbayd Allah ibn al-Walīd al-Waṣṣāfī.

key_terms.ابْنِ فَضَّالٍ: Ibn Faḍḍāl, a narrator in the chain
key_terms.الْعَطَّارِ: al-ʿAṭṭār, a narrator in the transmission chain
key_terms.الْوَصَّافِيِّ: al-Waṣṣāfī, the transmitter to whom this chain leads
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I transmitted it; a statement of direct transmission by the compiler
key_terms.عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْوَلِيدِ الْوَصّ: ʿUbayd Allah ibn al-Walīd al-Waṣṣāfī, the named source at the end of the chain

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to al-Waṣṣāfī in Man lā yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage gives the sanad/isnad for reports transmitted from al-Waṣṣāfī in Man lā yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh. It serves as a chain clarification, identifying the line of transmission through which the author received these hadith.
